Google Meet attendance tracking for webinars, workshops & training

Whether you are running corporate compliance training, paid workshops, CME/CLE continuing education courses, or live customer onboarding webinars, you need verifiable proof of attendance. Here is how to generate audit-ready attendance sheets with exact duration timestamps.
Webinar & Training Attendance Tracking
Google Sheets export for training and webinar attendance
Why Standard Video Attendance Isn't Enough for Training
For accredited or corporate sessions, a simple head count does not satisfy compliance requirements:
Minimum Duration Thresholds: Continuing education credits often require attendees to be present for at least 80% or 90% of the scheduled session.
Disconnection & Rejoin Tracking: If an attendee loses internet connection and reconnects, you need an aggregate calculation of their total active time.
Certificate Issuance: To grant completion certificates, training administrators need a clean spreadsheet showing student names, verified emails, and exact minutes spent in the room.
How Attendance Tracker Delivers Audit-Ready Records
1. Real-Time Duration Calculation

Attendance Tracker continuously records every participant's join time and leave time using the Google Meet REST API. If a user drops off and rejoins, multiple participant sessions are combined into a single accurate duration total.
2. Formatted Google Sheets Export
Immediately after your webinar or workshop concludes, the report is saved directly to your Google Drive. The exported sheet contains:
Attendee Full Name & Email
First Join Timestamp & Final Leave Timestamp
Total Minutes in Call
Attendance Status (Present, Left Early, Absent, Excused)
3. Multi-Session Workshop Series Roll-up
If your training course spans multiple modules or weeks, Attendance Tracker groups all sessions by your Google Calendar recurring event ID to show overall course completion percentages per person.
Ideal for:
Corporate HR & Compliance Officers: Document mandatory security, safety, and DEI training completion.
Professional Certification Providers: Issue CME, CLE, CPA, or PMI continuing education credits based on verified minutes attended.
Customer Success & Onboarding Teams: Track customer participation during live software onboarding bootcamps.
Paid Webinar Hosts: Validate ticketed attendees against event registration lists.
